- **Tools**: Docker, Git, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS

### Professional Experience

- Designed and implemented LangChain-based agent systems
- Reduced manual processing time by 80% through intelligent automation
- Led team of 5 engineers in developing microservices architecture

**Automation Engineer** | StartupXYZ | 2020-2022
- Developed custom n8n nodes and integrations for enterprise clients
- Created AI agents for customer support, reducing response time by 60%
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows

### Education
**BS Computer Science** | University Name | 2019

### Certifications
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect
- OpenAI API Specialist

assignments.name: normalized_company_website
assignments.value: ={{(() => { const raw = $json.companyWebsite || ''; if (!raw) { return ''; } const normalized = raw.match(/^https?:\/\//) ? raw : `https://${raw}`; return normalized.replace(/\/$/, ''); })()}}

assignments.name: company_domain
assignments.value: ={{(() => { const raw = ($json.companyWebsite || '').replace(/^https?:\/\//, ''); const parts = raw ? raw.split('/') : []; return (parts.length ? parts[0] : '').toLowerCase(); })()}}

assignments.name: email_search_urls
assignments.value: ={{(() => { const website = $json.companyWebsite || ''; if (!website) { return JSON.stringify([]); } const normalized = website.match(/^https?:\/\//) ? website : `https://${website}`; const trimmed = normalized.replace(/\/$/, ''); const base = (() => { try { const url = new URL(trimmed); return `${url.protocol}//${url.host}`; } catch (error) { return trimmed; } })(); const candidates = [base, `${base}/careers`, `${base}/team`, `${base}/people`, `${base}/about`, `${base}/contact`, `${base}/company`]; return JSON.stringify(Array.from(new Set(candidates.filter(Boolean)))); })()}}

assignments.name: email_search_context
assignments.value: ={{(() => { const raw = ($json.companyWebsite || '').replace(/^https?:\/\//, ''); const parts = raw ? raw.split('/') : []; const domain = (parts.length ? parts[0] : '').toLowerCase(); return JSON.stringify({ company: $json.company, title: $json.title, location: $json.location, domain, jobUrl: $json.jobUrl || $json.url || $json.link || $json.jobUrlCleaned || '', description: $json.description || '' }); })()}}
